A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same EchoStyle work, and their text, equations, tables, and figures are readable. V1 includes Appendices A–C; the supplied v2 ends after the references. Their omission is verifiable, rather than an extraction gap.

before.justification: V1 reports original video-stylization experiments, quantitative comparisons, human ratings, and architecture, data-scaling, and temporal-overlap analyses.

after.justification: V2 retains original quantitative comparisons and human ratings in Tables 1–2, qualitative results, long-video experiments, and main-text ablations.

M1.justification: Sections 3.1–3.3 retain the same channel-concatenation architecture, flow-matching objective, LoRA training, reverse-synthesis pipeline, and init-follow sliding-window procedure. Removed appendix implementation details do not establish an algorithm change.

E1.justification: Both retain V-Style20k with 14 training styles, the 50-pair evaluation spanning nine styles, and cinematic long-video evaluation. Removed subset analyses and supplementary examples concern the existing stylization coverage, without establishing a different dataset or task.

E2.justification: Tables 1–2 retain AnyV2V, VACE-Depth, VACE-Flow, Runway, Kling-O1, and Seedance2.0. The Kling-O1 long-video comparison and ControlNet/In-context architecture comparisons also remain. Appendix removal reduces supporting evidence without changing these comparator sets.

E3.justification: V2 no longer reports the supplementary designs comparing a 6k-pair, four-style training subset against the full dataset or testing 1-, 8-, and 16-frame overlaps. Settings for retained experiments remain unchanged; missing evaluation instructions do not demonstrate that those procedures changed.

E4.justification: Removing Appendix A eliminates the data-scaling study, overlap-length sensitivity study, and detailed quantitative and visual architecture analysis in Tables 3–4 and Figures 9–11. Section 4.4 and Figure 8 retain the shorter architecture and init-follow ablations, but substantial diagnostic evidence is lost.

E5.justification: Both specify global seed 42 and the seed+rank strategy in Section 4.1. Neither reports repeated-run uncertainty, confidence intervals, or significance tests, and no uncertainty-reporting practice changes.

E6.justification: All scores in Tables 1–2 are unchanged. V2 removes the architecture results in Table 3 and scaling results in Table 4, including S-set/B-set style similarities of 0.488/0.512, alongside supplementary qualitative findings in Figures 9–13. These are withdrawn results, not same-setting performance changes.

T1.justification: Equations (1)–(8), the dataset and input-output definitions, training objective, and long-video recurrence remain unchanged. The omitted appendices contain empirical discussion and instructions, not additional formal proofs or derivations.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions: arbitrary-length text-driven stylization, reverse-synthesized V-Style20k, init-follow extension, and performance comparable to commercial models. Removing supporting evidence does not itself revise these claims.

C2.justification: V2 removes Appendix A's explanations connecting alignment to inductive bias, larger training coverage to stylistic generalization, and overlap length to coherence versus computation. Main-text interpretations remain, but these substantive supporting explanations and tradeoffs disappear.

D1.justification: V2 removes the five-point human-rating rubric and normalization, exact model-evaluation prompts, in-context baseline implementation details, and specified eight-frame default inference overlap. Main training hyperparameters and hardware remain documented. This substantially reduces reproducibility information without demonstrating changed execution.

R1.justification: V2 adds four references concerning preference scheduling, reasoning stopping, reward modeling, and low-light restoration. Sections 2.1 and 4.2 modestly broaden contextual links to restoration and alignment research; the central novelty positioning remains unchanged.

P1.justification: V2 removes the entire three-part appendix structure: Experimental Discussions, Evaluation Instructions, and Supplementary Visual Results, without integrating it elsewhere. The surviving main-text organization is stable, with localized prose edits in Sections 2.1 and 4.2 and retained references to the now-absent supplement.

P2.justification: Tables 3–4, Figures 9–13, and both evaluation-prompt listings disappear, substantially reducing the experimental and instructional displays. Figures 1–8 and Tables 1–2 retain their content, with minor placement and surrounding pagination changes.

improvement.justification: As supplied, v2 substantially weakens evidential support and reproducibility by removing quantitative architecture and scaling analyses, overlap-sensitivity evidence, and exact evaluation instructions while retaining the associated claims and supplementary-material references. The unchanged main results preserve the central contribution, but the limited contextual benefit of four added citations does not compensate for these losses.
